replies.body:
Agreed on `error.type`. I also checked some providers and they bill for tokens when a stream errors or cancel/deadline exceeded
AI Table for checking providers

| Scenario (`error.type` set) | Anthropic | OpenAI | Google Gemini | | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | | Upfront 4xx/5xx | Unbilled, no `usage` | Unbilled, no `usage` | Unbilled, no `usage` | | Mid-stream error / timeout / abort (e.g. `overloaded_error`, `APITimeoutError`, `APIUserAbortError`) | Billed (input + partial output); client gets `input_tokens`, `cache_read_input_tokens`, `cache_write_input_tokens` in `message_start` (misses final `output_tokens` in `message_delta`) | Billed on timeout/abort (input + partial output); `usage` is only sent in the final chunk, so usually missing on client | Billed on timeout/abort; early chunks include `promptTokenCount` / `cachedContentTokenCount`, while final `candidatesTokenCount` arrives in the last chunk |
